bugs.error_message: NameError: cannot access free variable 'datetime' where it is not associated with a value in enclosing scope — streaming chat crashes on every message
bugs.root_cause: A lambda `now = lambda: datetime.now().strftime(...)` inside `_prepare_chat_context` (an async method) caused Python's bytecode compiler to classify `datetime` as a free variable from the enclosing scope rather than a global. When the lambda is invoked, Python cannot resolve the cell reference, raising NameError. The 200 OK response is already sent by the time the stream generator raises, so the client sees no error — the stream just terminates silently.
bugs.fix: Removed the lambda. Inlined the call: `print(f"\n[AGENT] [{datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] ...")`. No closure involved, `datetime` is now resolved as a plain global.
